title: The two conjugations and real Frobenius
as_he_states: He states that the Betti conjugation σ and the real de Rham descent conjugation τ commute, with τσ=στ=f_R, and that f_R interchanges the Hodge filtrations.
plausible_today: For a real smooth projective variety and its rational Betti realization, f_R is the linear involution induced by geometric complex conjugation. Rationality gives σf_R=f_Rσ; putting τ=f_Rσ yields τ²=1 and commutation. The Hodge-torus relation is f_Rj(z)f_R^−1=j(conj z).
state_of_art: D71 §§2.1–2.2 supplies the conjugate Hodge and real-structure framework; DM12 §6.17 and §§6.22–6.25 distinguish Artin and geometric structures. The elementary semilinear calculation is redone in computations.md §2, with all four sign parities in C02.

title: Are ordinary and twisted Betti tensor-isomorphic?
as_he_states: He tentatively says it seems that Betti^T and Betti are not tensor-isomorphic and identifies their difference with the cocycle of real Frobenius.
plausible_today: The answer depends on the tensor category. On a category containing the nontrivial real Artin sign object A with A⊗A≃1, the two Q-fiber functors are not tensor-isomorphic: the tensor constraint would require a rational square equal to−1. A pure Tate category alone does not supply this obstruction.
state_of_art: DM12 Prop6.17 identifies Artin motives with Galois representations and Thm3.2 identifies tensor-isomorphism torsors. The sign-object obstruction and the Tate-only distinction are proved explicitly in computations.md §2 and C02–C03.

title: Arithmetic period genericity as density of the actual cocycle image
